questions.q: What does Beba do at the start when his mother has disappeared?
o: Calls the police to report her missing
Goes to look for her at the market
questions.e: In the video: "Ja bih, molim vas, da prijavim nestanak majke." — I'd like to report my mother missing.

questions.q: Where does Ruža say she was?
questions.e: In the video: "Bila sam u šetnji." — I was out for a walk.

questions.q: What does Ruža say she hears?
questions.e: In the video: "Čujem neki mali glas." — I hear some little voice.

questions.q: What does Mum suggest Beba does to meet "them"?
questions.e: In the video: "Pa u orman." — Well, in the wardrobe.

questions.q: Who was the milk for, according to Ruža?
questions.e: In the video: "Nećete verovati, sve je to mleko za nju." — You won't believe it, all this milk is for her.

questions.q: How did Ruža find the organisation Let's Help the Elderly?
o: A friend gave it to her
questions.e: In the video: "Da, to sam ih našla na Fejsbuku pre neki dan kad sam povredila nogu." — yes, I found them on Facebook the other day when I hurt my leg.

questions.q: What does Beba warn Mum about regarding the social services visit?
o: That she may be sent to a nursing home
That her pension will be taken
That she'll be taken to hospital
questions.e: In the video: "Ali možda oni odluče da te pošalju u dom." — But maybe they'll decide to send you to a nursing home.

questions.q: What does Dragana promise at the end of the visit?
o: That they will now be brought two lunches
That she'll take Ruža to a home
questions.e: In the video: "Ja ću reći Milici da od sada donosi dva ručka." — I'll tell Milica to bring two lunches from now on.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ja bih, molim vas, da prijavim *nestanak* majke.
questions.e: nestanak — disappearance.

questions.q: Idem samo tu iza *ćoška*.
questions.e: ćoška — genitive of ćošak (corner).

questions.q: Jesu li pominjali leteće *tanjire*?
questions.e: leteći tanjiri — flying saucers.

questions.q: On je tako *infantilan*.
questions.e: infantilan — infantile.

questions.q: Ona je zdrava kao *dren*.
questions.e: zdrav kao dren — fit as a fiddle (literally: like dogwood).

questions.q: Pa ići ćeš u *zatvor*!
questions.e: zatvor — prison.

questions.q: Ja sam *usisala*, neću u dom, neću.
questions.e: usisati — to vacuum.

questions.q: Šta radite *utorak* uveče?
questions.e: utorak — Tuesday.

questions.q: Idem samo tu iza ___.
questions.e: The preposition "iza" takes the genitive: iza ćoška.

questions.q: Ja sam došla da pomognem vašoj ___, pošto je povredila nogu.
questions.e: Pomoći + dative: vašoj majci.

questions.q: Ali ti si lagala ___ organizaciju, mama.
questions.e: Organizaciju is feminine accusative, so the adjective: humanitarnu.

questions.q: Moja mama je danas došla i tvrdila mi ovde da se druži sa ___.
questions.e: Družiti se sa + instrumental plural: sa vanzemaljcima.

questions.q: Dobro, nećeš ići u ___, ne brini.
questions.e: Where to? U + accusative: u dom.

questions.q: Ja ću reći Milici da od sada donosi dva ___.
questions.e: After "dva" — genitive singular: dva ručka.

questions.q: Koliko dugo zoveš organizaciju Pomozimo ___?
questions.e: Pomoći + dative plural: starima.

questions.q: A ja sam to ___.
questions.e: A woman speaks: past feminine — primetila.
